// The pictures the tiles can show, each drawn in a 1000x1000 box. Every tile
// draws the whole picture through a window onto its own square of it, so a
// picture is kept to a dozen shapes.

// Dusk over the hills and a lake. `high` draws it in black and white.
const landscape = (high: boolean) =>
  high ? (
    <g>
      <rect x={0} y={0} width={1000} height={1000} fill="#ffffff" />
      <circle cx={690} cy={330} r={150} fill="#000000" />
      <circle cx={690} cy={330} r={205} fill="none" stroke="#000000" strokeWidth={16} />
      <polygon points="0,640 170,390 330,560 520,330 760,610 900,470 1000,560 1000,700 0,700" fill="#000000" />
      <rect x={0} y={700} width={1000} height={300} fill="#ffffff" />
      {[740, 800, 860, 920, 975].map((y, i) => (
        <rect x={60 + (i % 2) * 90} y={y} width={820 - (i % 2) * 120} height={22} rx={11} fill="#000000" />
      ))}
      <polygon points="80,170 130,140 180,170 130,155" fill="#000000" />
      <polygon points="240,110 280,86 320,110 280,98" fill="#000000" />
    </g>
  ) : (
    <g>
      <rect x={0} y={0} width={1000} height={700} fill="url(#sky)" />
      <circle cx={690} cy={420} r={150} fill="#f6d48b" />
      <polygon points="0,560 170,360 330,500 520,300 760,540 900,430 1000,500 1000,700 0,700" fill="#5a6b8a" />
      <polygon points="0,700 0,600 210,520 420,610 640,540 860,620 1000,580 1000,700" fill="#2e5e4e" />
      <rect x={0} y={700} width={1000} height={300} fill="url(#lake)" />
      <rect x={560} y={740} width={260} height={16} rx={8} fill="#f6d48b" />
      <rect x={610} y={800} width={160} height={14} rx={7} fill="#e8b97c" />
      <rect x={640} y={860} width={100} height={12} rx={6} fill="#d9a06b" />
      <polygon points="80,170 130,140 180,170 130,155" fill="#2b3a55" />
      <polygon points="240,110 280,86 320,110 280,98" fill="#2b3a55" />
    </g>
  )

// Rings around a point off the middle, with a band across them.
const rings = (high: boolean) => {
  const colors = high ? ['#000000', '#ffffff'] : ['#2c5f6e', '#e8b33a', '#c8553d', '#f3ecdc', '#4b3a8c', '#7fa88f']
  const parts = [<rect x={0} y={0} width={1000} height={1000} fill={high ? '#ffffff' : '#1f3a5f'} />]
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    parts.push(<circle cx={380} cy={420} r={900 - i * 75} fill={colors[i % colors.length]} />)
  }
  parts.push(<polygon points="0,880 1000,560 1000,700 0,1000" fill={high ? '#000000' : '#f3ecdc'} />)
  return <g>{parts}</g>
}

export const PICTURES = { landscape, rings }

// The gradients the color pictures use, defined once in the board's drawing.
export const PictureDefs = () => (
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="700">
      <stop offset="0" stopColor="#2b4c7e" />
      <stop offset="0.6" stopColor="#b9797a" />
      <stop offset="1" stopColor="#efb57f" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="lake" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="700" x2="0" y2="1000">
      <stop offset="0" stopColor="#3d5a80" />
      <stop offset="1" stopColor="#1f3350" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
)
